items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Worked with Louie when he come out there with Leon.

ctx.x: I worked with Leon when he owned the Avalon Club out here in Metry. Worked with Louie when he come out there with Leon. You worked at the Pumpkin too, I'm kind of late. I didn't work with the Pumpkin though. Who was that with the Pumpkin?

I worked at the Pumpkin with Leo Ede on drums. And myself on... Where'd I play trumpet? What about the Prima boys? What about the Prima boys? Did you ever work with any? Leon and Louie? Yeah, I worked with both of them. I worked with Leon when he owned the Avalon Club out here in Metry. Worked with Louie when he come out there with Leon. You worked at the Pumpkin too, I'm kind of late.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: I didn't work with the Pumpkin too, I'm kind of late. I didn't work with the Prima at the Pumpkin though.
